name: nonApi_importRunsPageRuns
description: Internal (no auth). Writes the runs the API's RunsPageImport read off a kennel's runs page (E3.F6.S3) into HC.Event the way every inbound integration does: the source's values go into the Fb* mirror columns with the UseFb* flags on (RunDetails, Location, LatLon = 1; Image = 0), InboundIntegrationId = 6 and EventFacebookId = 'runspage:<run number>'. Rules: a run number new to the kennel becomes a run (AbsoluteEventNumber anchors the numbering; HC6.nonApi_updateRunNumbers is run for each); a number the kennel already has from any other source is LEFT ALONE ('already in Harrier Central'); a run this page brought in that was adopted (InboundIntegrationId 0) and then deleted stays deleted; an imported run (still on integration 6) gets its mirror refreshed — its start time only while it still equals the last import, its hares only while UseFbRunDetails = 1 — and counts 'update' only when something changed; a NEW run with no start, description, title or map link is skipped until the page fills it in; nothing is ever deleted. Rejected ('unreadable'): no number, number <= 0, no parseable date, or a date more than a year past / two years ahead. Placeholder hares (TBA/TBC/TBD, 'hare needed', 'volunteer'...) become no hares; a missing title becomes 'Run <n>'. EventStartDatetime is local wall-clock with +00:00 (house convention); HC.trgUpdateModifiedOnDateForEvent derives the GMT instant. @dryRun = 1 (the portal's Test) does everything inside a savepoint, reports, and rolls it back.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: The kennel. NULL returns zero counts and no outcomes (not an error).

parameters.name: runsJson
parameters.description: {"runs":[{"number","date" yyyy-MM-dd,"time" HH:mm,"title","hares","start","lat","lon","mapUrl","description","special"}]}. Not valid JSON returns zero counts and no outcomes.

parameters.name: dryRun
parameters.description: 1 = compute and report, write nothing (rolled back to the savepoint; nothing logged). Default 0.

rowsets.name: Counts
rowsets.description: Always one row (all zeros when @kennelId is NULL or @runsJson is not JSON).

columns.name: unchanged
columns.description: Imported runs read again with nothing new (matched minus updated).

columns.name: alreadyInHc
columns.description: Numbers the kennel already holds from another source, plus adopted-then-deleted runs.

columns.name: rejected
columns.description: Entries with no usable number or date.

columns.name: skipped
columns.description: New runs with no start, description, title or map link yet.

rowsets.name: Outcomes
rowsets.description: One row per entry on the page, by run number.

columns.name: EventNumber
columns.description: The page's run number (NULL when it was missing).

columns.name: Outcome
columns.description: 'new' | 'update' | 'unchanged' | 'already in Harrier Central' | 'deleted in Harrier Central' | 'skipped - no location or description yet' | 'unreadable'.

sideEffects: INSERT HC.Event for new runs (InboundIntegrationId 6, EventFacebookId 'runspage:<n>', EventSource 'Runs page', IsCountedRun 1, IsVisible 1, EventGeographicScope 2 when special else 1, kennel default prices and currency, AbsoluteEventNumber = page number, UseFb* 1/1/1/0).

UPDATE HC.Event mirror columns (FbEventStartDatetime, FbEventName, FbEventDescription, FbLocationOneLineDesc, FbLatitude/FbLongitude, FbEventMapUrl; EventStartDatetime when it still equals the old mirror; Hares when UseFbRunDetails = 1; EventGeolocation when UseFbLatLon = 1) for integration-6 runs that changed — each fires the Event updatedAt trigger and re-syncs.
EXEC HC6.nonApi_updateRunNumbers once per new run (cursor), inside the transaction.
INSERT LOG.GeneralLog ('runsPageImport') when not a dry run and something was inserted or updated.
Transaction with SAVE TRANSACTION runsPageImport: @dryRun = 1 rolls back to the savepoint then commits; the CATCH rolls back, INSERTs HC.ErrorLog ('<api>') and THROWs.

codeSmells.issue: Run numbers are INT in the staging table but SMALLINT on HC.Event
codeSmells.detail: #runs.EventNumber is INT (line 69) and is written to AbsoluteEventNumber SMALLINT (lines 217, 226). A page run number above 32767 fails the INSERT with an arithmetic overflow, which the CATCH logs and re-throws as an unhandled error instead of reporting the entry 'unreadable'.

codeSmells.issue: Bad input is reported as an empty page
codeSmells.detail: Lines 52-57: a NULL @kennelId or non-JSON @runsJson returns zero counts and no outcomes rather than an error, so a reader bug looks like a page with nothing on it. Nothing is logged.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
